table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	serviceinvcode     = dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode,    
	date        = dbo.serviceOheader.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.serviceOheader.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.serviceOheader.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.serviceOheader.discperc, 
	invadvance = dbo.serviceOheader.cashreceived,
	post = dbo.serviceoheader.posted,
	servicesadvance = Sum (dbo.serviceOdetail.cashreceived),
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.serviceOdetail.price *  qty ), 2),    
	servicediscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( (dbo.serviceOdetail.price - dbo.serviceOdetail.serviceflatdisc) * qty * (dbo.serviceOdetail.discperc * .01)) ), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( ( dbo.serviceOdetail.price  - dbo.serviceOdetail.serviceflatdisc) * qty * (1 - (dbo.serviceOdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.serviceOheader.discperc /100), 2),
	salesman = dbo.users.username 
	
FROM 
	dbo.serviceOheader, 
	dbo.serviceOdetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode = dbo.serviceOdetail.serviceOcode ) and  
	( dbo.serviceOheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.serviceOheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
	( dbo.serviceOheader.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
	
GROUP BY 
	dbo.serviceOheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.date,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.serviceocode,    
	dbo.serviceOheader.discperc,  
	dbo.serviceOheader.cashreceived, 
	dbo.serviceoheader.posted, 
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username 
	
ORDER BY 
	dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode ASC,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.date ASC
